settings.title: Settings
settings.thaiReadingHint: Auto = hidden in Stages 1–5, shown in Stages 6–7 (Stages 1–3 show no text at all)
settings.translationHint: Keep it hidden so you can guess from the picture and sound first.
settings.voiceHint: Lesson words and sentences use a ready-made high-quality native voice (works offline). This choice is for sentences without a ready-made file. Voices named Natural or Google usually sound best.
settings.micPrivacy: The “Say it” button uses your browser's speech listening. Chrome and Edge send what you say to Google / Microsoft servers to turn it into text, so it needs the internet. This site doesn't record or keep your voice from this button.
settings.voiceFallbackNote: The online voice isn't working right now (maybe no internet), so the on-device voice “{{name}}” is used. It will switch back when you're online.

welcome.title: Welcome to English Town
welcome.subtitle: 3 things to know before you start

native.title: Learn like a native child
native.text: Native kids listen for a long time, then speak, read and write. Lessons here follow that order in 7 stages. Finish one stage to open the next.

guess.title: Listen, look, and guess
guess.text: At first there are no words to read. Listen and look at the picture. You remember better than when you translate.
guess.picture: Always guess from the picture and sound first. You don’t need every word.
guess.meaning: Want the Thai meaning? You can tap to see it any time.
guess.mistakes: Mistakes are fine. No lives to lose — you hear the right way, then try again.

daily.title: Get your mic ready, and learn a little every day
daily.text: Tap "Continue" on the home page. It always takes you to your next lesson.
daily.mic: Use Chrome or Edge, and allow the microphone when asked (Safari on iPhone does not hear speech well).
daily.daily: 5–20 minutes every day beats one long session. Your streak counts the days.
daily.review: Missed items come back for review. If you see "Review today", do it first.
